parts.premise: Interactive homework assignments can prove especially engaging—but homework should be done by kids, not parents. There isn’t a lot of research on which types of homework assignments are “best,” but some educators make the case that assignments that ask students to collaborate, whether with a peer or an adult, tend to be more engaging for students.
